Rat_Wounding
Necrotic Rats are a type of beast which can be found in the Gauntlet of Shar during Act Two.

Involvement

Necrotic Rats spawn alongside Soporific Rats while fighting the rat swarm in the Gauntlet of Shar, after killing a certain amount of rats. They spawn with increasing frequency as more rats are killed. They have a slightly higher Strength and Dexterity than regular rats, and their bite deals additional Necrotic damage.
